profile.headline: Power Platform Solution Architect, Department of Defense
profile.jobTitle: Sr. Software Engineer Power Platform Developer
profile.summary:
With over 13 years of hands-on experience in delivering scalable enterprise-grade applications, I specialize in transforming business operations using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) and Dataverse. My career has been driven by a mission: to turn complex problems into secure, user-friendly solutions that deliver measurable impact in federal agencies and Fortune 1000 enterprises.

I’ve led digital modernization efforts for organizations like the U.S. Navy, Philips, T-Mobile, and more—aligning technical strategy with business goals to optimize workflows, improve data visibility, and accelerate ROI.

🔧 Core Competencies:

Power Platform Architecture (Canvas + Model-Driven Apps)

Dataverse Configuration & Governance

Enterprise Workflow Automation

Legacy System Integration

SharePoint & Microsoft 365 Ecosystems

Power BI Dashboards & Reporting

Agile Delivery & Stakeholder Engagement

✨ What Sets Me Apart:

Proven ability to design and scale low-code/no-code platforms that reduce manual effort by 40–60%

Expertise in crafting secure Fed-compliant solutions with active DoD clearance

Passion for mentoring and knowledge-sharing—empowering teams to adopt and own their tools

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer Power Platform Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Developed and deployed custom business applications using Microsoft Power Platform, collaborating with stakeholders to ensure security and compliance standards.

• Designed and deployed custom business applications using Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI.
• Collaborated with stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver user-friendly applications.
• Ensured solutions adhered to security, compliance, and governance standards.

positions.title: Power Platform Solution Architect
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Designed and implemented secure, scalable solutions for federal clients, ensuring compliance with DoD standards and enhancing operational efficiency.

Collaborated with Navy stakeholders to develop responsive applications, improving project timelines and mission-critical operations.

Configured Dataverse entities, enhancing data management capabilities and ensuring data integrity across platforms.

Developed custom workflows using Power Automate, streamlining integration processes and reducing processing time.

Provided ongoing user support and training, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and enhancing team productivity.

Keywords: Power Platform, Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Federal Compliance, DoD Standards, Workflow Automation

company.name: The Marlin Alliance, Inc., U.S. Navy Projects

positions.title: Sr. Power Platform Developer/Lead Business System Analyst
positions.description:
Architected and deployed Power Platform solutions, integrating PowerApps with Dataverse and legacy systems to streamline critical business processes.

Developed scalable Model-Driven and Canvas Apps, supporting enterprise workflows and automating operational processes.

Implemented solutions with custom APIs, business rules, and command bar customizations, enhancing user experience and functionality.

Built and maintained Power BI dashboards, providing real-time insights into performance metrics and KPIs.

Integrated Power Platform with Microsoft 365 tools, including SharePoint Online, Teams, and Outlook, improving collaboration and productivity.

Keywords: Power Platform, Power Apps, Model-Driven Apps, Canvas Apps, Power BI, Microsoft 365 Integration, Legacy System Integration
positions.insights: Skills: Teamwork · Application Lifecycle Management · Development Work

positions.title: Senior Sharepoint Consultant
positions.description:
Led development and deployment of SharePoint Online and On-Prem solutions for business-critical applications.

Customized forms, workflows, and interfaces using SharePoint Designer, PowerApps, and Flow, enhancing user engagement and operational efficiency.

Facilitated cross-departmental workshops, gathering feedback to develop solutions that met diverse stakeholder needs.

Implemented PowerApps applications, streamlining data collection and improving data accuracy across departments.

Keywords: SharePoint Online, SharePoint Designer, PowerApps, Workflow Automation, User Engagement

company.name: ARCH Resources by GEPAE, Grant County PUD

positions.title: Business Analyst 3/ SharePoint Developer/SharePoint Migration Expert
positions.description:
Created and maintained the NA Sales Leadership Daily Management Portal in Microsoft SharePoint O365, centralizing sales operations data.

Migrated over 200 SharePoint O365 sites, consolidating them into a cohesive platform using Microsoft Flow and Power BI.

Supported Sales Operations with tools and processes related to position alignment, organizational restructuring, and planning readiness.

Managed sales participant databases, implementing audit schedules to ensure accurate data for HR, Finance, and Sales Operations.

Keywords: SharePoint O365, Microsoft Flow, Power BI, Sales Operations, Data Management

positions.title: SharePoint Developer/SharePoint Migration Expert
positions.description:
Developed custom and out-of-box SharePoint O365 solutions, enhancing internal and external portals.

Consolidated and streamlined SharePoint architecture, preserving branding, version history, and permissions during migration.

Designed interactive intranet applications for secure compensation communications with acknowledgment tracking.

Extended Content Query Web Part (CQWP) with XSL templates, enabling dynamic UI customization through XML stored in SharePoint lists.

Keywords: SharePoint O365, Migration, Intranet Applications, CQWP, UI Customization

positions.title: SharePoint Developer/SharePoint Migration Expert
positions.description:
Responsible for defining the migration approach, migration schedule and developing out of the box solutions for 3rd party tools not available in O365.  As well as all custom master pages, page layouts and branding. 

•	Working with primary stakeholder to identify content to be mapped from local file share to O365 and configure migration to tag all content with Metadata
•	Develop project plan, define project technology strategy by understanding key client objectives; diagnosing and mapping client requirements; articulating solution risks and barriers; recommending project approaches; 
•	Facilitate information gathering sessions to validate business cases, gather and document business and functional objectives
•	Implement migration by building components and custom designs; prototyping; data migration; maintaining artifact integrity and consistency
•	Enhance overall team accomplishments and competence by planning delivery of solutions; answer technical and procedural questions for less-experienced team members; teach improved processes; mentor team members
•	Facilitate UAT and End User Training of new environment
•	Utilize Azure Blob Storage and Development

positions.title: SharePoint Architect/SharePoint Migration Expert
positions.description:
Responsible for defining the migration approach, identifying the content owners and leading the migration to OS365.  Deep SharePoint knowledge and the ability to architect SharePoint solutions by mapping common customer business problems to end-to-end technology solutions.

• Develop project technology strategy by understanding key client objectives; diagnosing and mapping client requirements; articulating solution risks and barriers; recommending project approaches; preparing time and cost estimates; planning full project life cycle
• Facilitate information gathering sessions to validate business cases, gather and document business and functional objectives
• Implement migration by building components and custom designs; prototyping; data migration; maintaining artifact integrity and consistency
• Manage customer relationship by communicating SharePoint architecture standards and frameworks; answering questions; resolving concerns and issues
• Increase organization effectiveness by identifying opportunities to leverage solutions from other engagements
• Enhance overall team accomplishments and competence by planning delivery of solutions; answer technical and procedural questions for less-experienced team members; teach improved processes; mentor team members
• Improve information usefulness by tracking emerging technologies; evaluating their applicability to business goals and operational requirements

positions.title: SharePoint Genius / SharePoint Migration Expert
positions.description:
Primary focus on SharePoint migrations to O365, 2013 and 2016 and content delivery.  Establish solid and productive working relationships with internal and external clients to meet, and exceed, requirements in order to deliver projects on time and within a budget. Involved in all phases of a migration from pre-planning to UAT remediation. 

Working directly with the team, been instrumental in creating a project plan for each migration based on priority and level of effort, ensuring that all custom development work is outlined.  Actively involved in addressing any areas of concern prior to migration, making recommendations for resource staffing for custom development efforts

positions.title: Senior Solutions Manager
positions.description:
•	Drive complex IT projects through software development lifecycle to completion
•	Succinctly define schedule and manage scope of project deliverables
•	Provide excellent customer service to client
•	SharePoint: Manage Site Collections, including content, permissions, enhancement requests, and bug fixes
•	Work with Site Owners and users to properly educated on site features and functionality
•	Facilitate bug triage and track issue cause, resolution and user acceptance seamlessly using bug/issue tracking tools as necessary
•	Create new SharePoint pages, lists, libraries, and sub-sites to meet business requirements
•	Document and track client requirements and craft work items for development
•	Work with Architects and UX designers to define use interface and technical construction of solution meeting client requirements
•	Clearly communicate requirements and development requests to off-shore development team
•	Visit client location as appropriate to provide support and good will
•	Provide regular written reports and status updates to client
•	Collaborate with project management team to develop synergy across projects
•	Assist in defining internal project management processes and best practices
•	Establish internal mentoring and monitoring program for project management team

positions.title: Technical Project Manager
positions.description:
•	Work directly with Clients and agree upon the deliveries, Schedules / Timelines. This includes managing the scope of the project, CRs, priorities and clarifying requirements. 
•	Work with all project stakeholders including client team / PMs, Functional / Business Analysts and other developers to ensure that the team works on right priorities, specifications and delivers quality code and standards. 
•	Scheduling and Running weekly status meeting with Management team
•	Work closely with Dev leads to get LOE’s of features.
•	Run Daily Scrum for Project
•	Assist Feature Breakdown tasks and dev assignments
•	Work closely with QA team. This includes, Bug Workflows and Triaging.
•	Track and Report Defect to Features ratio; Report quality metrics to management team

positions.title: Web Developer/ Solutions and Configuration Engineer/UAT
positions.description:
Analyze, develop, maintain, and administer scripts, servers, and systems for internet and intranet websites. 
Key deliverables include but are not limited to: 
•	  Responsible for building the look-and-feel designs outlined by project documentation, specifications, and wireframes and redlines.
•	  Develop standards-compliant, cross-browser web applications utilizing HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, XML, XSLT, object-oriented design, and requirements analysis
•	  Website / webpage design, page templates, web server configuration 
•	  Implement configuration-centric SharePoint based solutions from wireframe diagrams or technical specifications
•	  Work through a project manager or directly with clients on projects of various sizes
•	  Work independently in determining optimal solution approach
•	  Ability to work with 3rd party web parts (e.g., Bamboo Solutions, Metalogix, AvePoint)
•	  Understands and implements  best practice quality standards
•	  Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines
•	  Responsible for writing technical documentation 
•	  Develop and present User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
•	  Prepare training material for content publishers
•	  Prepare final technical specification from draft materials from development team
•	  Edit and own completion of ops guide
•	  Edit and own completion of deployment guide

positions.title: Senior System Engineer
positions.description:
•	Understands and participates in high-level and detailed project estimating, planning, and deliverable elements
•	Performs project assessments and participates in project implementations in one or more key areas: security, consolidation, testing, deployment, migration
•	Understands and delivers on the infrastructure development process, including developing installs/builds, designing server, application, and deployment configurations, and developing administration guidelines and documentation for both workstations and servers
•	Leads the administration of servers and workstations, and analysis and resolution of technical issues
•	Leads the development of test, automation and deployment scripts, test cases, and operational instructions and documentation
•	Understands and implements quality standards
•	Proficient in knowledge of Server Platforms and in Desktop and Server deployments
•	Proficient in knowledge of other key Microsoft technologies, including Management applications, Enterprise Communications applications, Server Platforms, and General technical knowledge of Microsoft server OS platforms (i.e. Windows XP, Vista, Server 2003)
•	Proficient in Microsoft server and desktop applications, networking principles, and systems integration
•	Documents configuration, migration, testing, deployment solutions
•	Has solution development, customer-interfacing and project lifecycle responsibilities in a customer-facing role.

positions.title: System Analyst
positions.description:
•	Work with the business to identify ways to improve the efficiency of their process with improvements to workflow and how best to leverage MOSS 2007 for this purpose.
•	Make recommendations to the business on how best to translate their SharePoint requirements into a viable technical solution that meets the process and mission of the individual departments involved.
•	Work with the developers to create the best possible user experienced based on feedback from the business and individual end users.  This includes additions/enhancements to the UI, providing custom site templates and branding.
•	Work with the Systems Architecture and Application Support teams to ensure that we deploy an environment that best meets the needs of T-Mobile.  This includes maintaining separate development and QAT environments, creating a maintenance strategy, data migration, and providing the associated documentation for each.
•	Provide role based training for the end users.
•	Work with the business to evaluate available SharePoint tools and utilities.  This includes out of the box solutions and 3rd party products.   The evaluation process includes creating the required documentation to support the findings for each individual request.
•	Create documentation to support the SharePoint environment at T-Mobile this includes best practices, system architecture, as well as roles and responsibilities.
•	Part of the team that is evaluating migration from MOSS 2007 to SharePoint 2010.  Also was a member of the team that developed the plan to move from 32 bit architecture to 64 bit.  I also helped develop our Vendor Extranet and continue to manage this environment.

positions.title: System Administrator/Customer Liaison/Trainer
positions.description:
•	Responsible for building, deploying, administering, troubleshooting, and day to day support of  MOSS 2007, and related SQL Server environments; which include Development, Test and Production.  Additionally was responsible for the complete the migration from SharePoint 2003, configuration, administration and deployment of MOSS 2007 from a 32bit environment to 64 bit. 
•	Additional duties include design, develop, and maintain SharePoint 2003 and MOSS 07 templates and workflows.  Monitor SharePoint and MOSS 07 server logs, activities, events, and assets.  As well as audit and report on system usage and activities on a monthly and quarterly basis.  I am also responsible to resolves issues relating to the content creation and publishing of web properties. 
•	Perform tasks related to delegating SharePoint content administrator roles to appropriate users. 
•	Perform end user administration as necessary, including managing SharePoint user accounts and troubleshooting user access problems.
•	Key contributor to the future vision of the tools and capabilities of SharePoint as it aligns with priorities of IT and end user community.  Part of the SharePoint 2010 design and implementation team.
•	Provide SharePoint implementation guidance and consulting to the business and community of site owners regarding site design, collaboration, project team communications, and content management strategies. 
•	Oversee the site request process: review submittals, ensure site creation

positions.title: Specialist 3 / Change Control Team
positions.description:
•	Monitor accuracy of change requests in Remedy database through heavy email and phone use. 
•	Update requests as instructed by requestors, approvers, and Change Board Manager. Generate periodic reports on changes in Remedy or snapshots converted to Excel.
•	Create communications associated with change control. This includes agendas and reports which used SharePoint to communicate to a wide audience nationwide.  
•	Is knowledgeable of and continuously enforces change control policies and procedures.  
•	Responds from time to time to down systems by providing relevant information on changes.
•	Be prepared to host weekly meeting if necessary.  Represents Change Control during other meetings when Change Board Manager is unavailable.  
•	Work with Remedy team to continually enhance functionality of change control process.   
•	Assist with change management process review; arrange meetings, interviews, track action items. 
•	Assist with Project Lifecycle efforts by tracking progress on application rollouts and system introductions. 
•	Assists with training of new employees regarding the Change Control process. 
•	As well as maintain the SharePoint Team Site.

positions.title: Project Manager 1 /Tax Analyst
positions.description:
Mobile
Responsible for scanning documents, pulling up the scans and inputting data contained on the scanned document. Running reports from system and analyzing the report data.

positions.title: Logistics-Finance Administrator
positions.description:
•	Manage all receivable information pertaining to each job and the status of the project. 
•	Make collection calls. Ensure billings are accurate and prepared timely.
•	Apprise the VP of Operations of progress towards deadlines and goals. 
•	Reconcile accounts. Verify orders information and proforma invoice sales. 
•	Initiate domestic order purchasing from domestic vendors. 
•	Provide impeccable customer service. 
•	Strong aptitude in logic, reasoning, problem solving and attention to detail.

positions.title: Office Administration Manager
positions.description:
•	Provide administrative support to the office manager and project managers with word processing and administrative office needs,
•	Responsible for administrative support to the Managing Director, manage supervisors' calendar and schedules appointments.
•	Direct preparation of records such as agenda, notices, minutes and incoming correspondence, proofreading reports and contracts, custodian of corporate documents and records for assigned office
•	Create and maintain database, spreadsheets and files, prepare technical reports and proposals. 
•	Maintain and monitor all incoming contracts from clients, assist Project Managers with special projects.
